about: The one source of every voice line: Godot's VoiceBank plays and subtitles these, and tools/gen_voices.py synthesises them (ElevenLabs, or through fal). Drop a line's .ogg at its 'file' path and the game uses it, timed to its real length. Priorities: intro, boss_spawn, death, the act openings and the bosses' lines 3 > ult and low_hp 2 > kill_streak 1 > cast 0. An 'escalation' line answers a moment of its own (VoiceDirector): burning_12 (12+ foes burning), hp_30 (life under 30%), ricochet_2 (a bolt's second ricochet), conduct (lightning through water or a crystal); 'random': false keeps it out of the cue's ordinary picks. See docs/VOICES.md.

warden.name: Warden
warden.direction: Stoic, gravelly, oath-bound vanguard baritone. Low and unhurried; every line lands like a vow. Never shouts except on the ultimate.

spark.name: Sparkcaller
spark.direction: Fast, bright, irreverent arcane skirmisher. Quick tempo, playful, a cheeky lift at the end of a line; real alarm only when hurt.

ember.name: Emberwitch
ember.direction: Low, smoky, feverish contagion pyromancer obsessed with spreading ash and fire. Breathy, intimate, unsettling delight that rises to rapture as the blaze grows.

storm.name: Stormwright
storm.direction: Cold, commanding, formal tempest scholar. Crisp diction, a lecturing cadence, no warmth; pleasure only in being proven right.

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.direction: Weathered dark-fantasy chronicler. Slow and grave, a storyteller's warmth under the gravel. The cold open's four beats are short and spaced, each a breath on its own.

tyrant.name: Tyrant
tyrant.direction: Menacing warlord. Deep, slow, contemptuous, savouring every threat. The VoiceBoss bus pitches it down 10% and adds reverb in game.

herald.name: The Shard Herald
herald.direction: Cold crystalline entity. Glassy, distant, sing-song calm, as if reciting a hymn it wrote. Pitched down 10% with reverb in game.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: I am the Warden, sworn to hold the breach. Whatever crawls out of that rift must pass through my blades first, and nothing has yet.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: Steel answers, as it has always answered me, without hesitation.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: Hold fast. These old blades still remember their work.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: Step closer, then, and bleed for the privilege of it.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: Blades, awaken! Become a storm of whirling steel around me!

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: By my oath, not one of you is left standing!

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: They fall like summer wheat before the scythe, row on row.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: Another rank broken. Send me the next one, and quickly.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: I have bled far worse than this before. Stand, Warden.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: On my oath, this wall does not fall today!

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: So the master finally shows itself. Good. Come down here, then.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: My watch... is ended... forgive me, my brothers...

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Sparkcaller, at your service! Frost in one hand, a truly terrible sense of humour in the other. Do try to keep up, won't you?

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Chill out, would you? Honestly, everyone around here is so tense.

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Brr! Bet that one really stings, doesn't it, big fella?

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Off the stone, twice, and straight through all of you!

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Absolute Zero! Everybody freeze! And I do mean everybody!

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Hold perfectly still now, this only takes forever, I promise!

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Ha! Was that the entire army? Seriously, was that really it?

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Keep them coming, I'm only just starting to warm up!

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Ow! Okay, okay, that one actually counted, apparently!

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Not great! This is very much, extremely, not great!

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Oh, wonderful. Would you look at the sheer size of that?

lines.speaker: spark
lines.text: Well... that's... deeply, profoundly, cosmically inconvenient...

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Every ember wants a home, and every home wants to burn. Come closer, little moths, and let me share my fever with every one of you.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Burn for me, darling, and then pass it on to a friend.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Catch the fever, little one. Spread it nice and wide.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Ash to ash, and every bit of flesh to hungry flame.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Let it all burn! Cataclysm, take every last one of them!

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Breathe in the ash, my darlings. Breathe it in deep.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Look how beautifully they smoulder, all of them together now.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: A dozen candles lit and counting! Burn brighter for me, darlings!

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: My flame is guttering. Feed it to me, and quickly!

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Not yet... not while I am still burning this bright.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Finally, something big enough to burn properly. How delicious.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Even embers... grow cold... eventually... don't they...

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: I am the Stormwright. Forty years I have studied the tempest, and today the sky will answer to my every word, or be corrected.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: Observe closely. The sky strikes precisely where I say it will.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: Precisely as I calculated. Do take note of that, please.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: The water conducts. Every one of you is wired to my storm.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: Heavens, open at my command! Behold, the Thunderdome!

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: Witness now the full and final lecture of the storm.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: The hypothesis holds. They break, exactly as I predicted.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: A most thorough demonstration, if I do say so myself.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: An error in my calculations. Correcting it immediately.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: Composure. A true storm does not panic, not ever.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: A worthy subject at last. Let the experiment begin.

lines.speaker: storm
lines.text: The storm... passes... from my hands... at last...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The sky cracked. Shards fell.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every shard tore a rift.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hunger poured into the world.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Four exiles answer the breach.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mossglen Hollow. Its oaks drink shardlight now, and the wisps that once led weary travellers home lead them down among the roots instead.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Cinder Wastes. Ash falls here like a winter that never ends, and beneath the black crust something very old is waking hungry.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Gravebound Crypt. Its kings were buried holding shards to light the road below. The light rose up again, and the dead rose with it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Neon Rift, where the Veil tore down to the bone and the hidden lattice of the world shines through, humming, cold and patient.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Drowned Cathedral. The tide climbs the nave, the bells ring on beneath the water, and down in the dark the first shard is listening.

lines.speaker: tyrant
lines.text: Kneel, little exile. You walked into my rift on your own two feet, and I promise you will leave it in a great many pieces.

lines.speaker: tyrant
lines.text: No... my rift... my throne... it all falls...

lines.speaker: herald
lines.text: I am the Herald of the shards. I sing the next shardfall, and your small, bright, fragile world will never outlast my song.

lines.speaker: herald
lines.text: The song... will be sung... again... and again...
